name: LSD
tierNotes: Threshold: brick lines barely drifting; colors a notch cleaner than they should be (early colorSat + sharpenHalo carry this tier alone).
Light: color pop unmistakable, faint breathing on large surfaces; still deniable in motion.
Common: full edge-tangent drift, short rainbow-tinged trails; smooth-curve params reach midrange.
Strong: lattice surfaces in texture, long rainbow trails; late params (patternMask, hueDrift, flowWarp) wake up.

Heavy: reality folds into itself. The fractal tiling is now a living, recursive fold — the scene is kaleidoscopically mirrored, that fold is folded again into a denser self-similar lattice, the whole field domain-warps so it swims rather than sitting like a static mirror, and the gate relaxes so it spreads onto flat walls too (not just textured regions). Surfaces swim hard along their own contours (~2.4× the base tangent drift) and rainbow trails persist longer with a stronger spectral shift. Crucially distinct from DMT: the photo's own content and colour are what tile — no tunnel, no entities, no scene replacement — reality stays legible but geometry genuinely dominates it.
